What it does

Knowify is built around a question most software ignores: did that job actually make money? It tracks the estimate against real costs as the job progresses, so overruns show up while you can still react. Change orders and progress billing are handled as first-class features rather than afterthoughts.

Where the AI actually is

Light AI assistance; the core value is job costing and budget tracking.

Pros

  • Strong job costing — tracks estimate vs actual
  • Handles change orders properly
  • Built for trades, not generic project management

Cons

  • Takes time to set up properly

Who it suits

Built with General contractors, Remodelers & carpenters, Electricians in mind. Contractors who need to know whether a job actually made money.
